id: title:jonmcwest:open the trace dialog from every trace link in logs and metrics

review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend wiring to connect the Logs Viewer FAB to the Tracing Dialog, allowing users to open a trace dialog from a metric sample.
review.reason: Adds a new import for the tracing dialog hook and an onClick handler that opens the trace dialog with the trace ID. This establishes the frontend entry point for the tracing feature. However, the complete implementation, backend support, shared utilities, and access control are not shown, so the tier is conservative.
review.uncertainty: The tier is conservative because the backend implementation, shared utilities, and access control are not visible; the benefit relies on unverified backend support.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the `useOpenTraceDialog` hook or the `TraceDialog` component, nor does it show the backend or shared utilities that support the tracing and span lookup.
